gloss: to achieve; to accomplish; to attain

definitions.gloss: to achieve; to accomplish; to attain
definitions.explanation: To successfully complete or reach a goal, target, or objective that required effort. Implies a deliberate pursuit that has been fulfilled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{達成|たっせい}する。
⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ようやく⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We were finally able to achieve the sales target.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}した→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧な⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{達成|たっせい}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the cooperation of the entire team, we were able to accomplish the difficult task.

notes:
One of the most common words for achieving goals in both business and personal contexts. Almost always takes ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧ (goal) as its object.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{達成|たっせい}する — to achieve a goal
- ⟦{達成|たっせい}{感|かん}→達成感：05952_tasseikan⟧ — sense of achievement
- ⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ — achievement rate
- ⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ — degree of achievement
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{達成|たっせい}する — to accomplish an objective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成|な}し{遂|と}げる→成し遂げる：12632_nashitogeru⟧ — to accomplish, achieve; more literary and emphasizes the difficulty overcome
- ⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to realize, bring about; broader, used for dreams, plans, and abstract goals
- ⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ — to fulfill (a duty, promise, role); focuses on completing an obligation
